ns2:course.label: Thesis Think Tank
ns2:course.description: Prepares dance majors for designing a feasible senior thesis project. Students will engage in weekly assignments that help them navigate a project plan that will result in an "approved" thesis proposal. The Undergraduate Faculty reviews each of the Senior Thesis Proposals through a 'blind read' assessment. Successful course completion is dependent on a faculty approved senior thesis proposal. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: For Dance majors only.
